summary: Only an OpenStreetMap point tagged fire lookout at 31.60, -90.05 in Mississippi. A 2020 state list has a Lawrence County Tower that may match; identity and status unconfirmed.

facts.status_note: We could not confirm that a structure stands at this map point.

events.note: Lawrence County Tower is listed under the Forestry Commission, State in a list dated July 29, 2020. Whether it is this point is unconfirmed.

corrections.why: The only source is an OpenStreetMap point mapped as a tower; no source we read confirms that a structure stands there now.

notes_for_editor: Identity unconfirmed. The OSM point is not in the NHLR Mississippi list; the only Lawrence name in the 2020 state list is Lawrence County Tower, and the list gives no coordinates, so a match cannot be checked. The OSM edit comment mentions Fire Tower Road, which we could not place. The OSM page says the point was edited almost 6 years ago, so the year 2020 is our estimate. Searches: 2 WebSearch. Page reads: 4 distinct.
